description: Bringing ArkOS and dArkOS porting to unsupported RK3326 handheld gaming devices.

latest_release.name: ArkOS4Clone-20261126
latest_release.body:
The previous release was tested on the R46H, where I discovered numerous bugs on devices with rotated screens. The system was practically unusable on these devices. I sincerely apologize for this.

As a result, I prepared an emergency update. This version has been tested on the R36MAX2 and R50H.

There may still be serious bugs that I haven't discovered during testing, so feel free to download and test it if you're interested.

1. Fixed a memory leak in SDL3 when using screen rotation, which could eventually cause OOM (Out of Memory).
2. Fixed Vulkan issues on rotated-screen devices in PPSSPP, PPSSPP2021, Flycast, and Flycast2022, where Vulkan either failed to work or displayed the image with incorrect rotation.
3. Added defensive safeguards to the 5.10 codec audio driver to reduce the maximum volume and prevent excessive audio output from potentially overdriving some low-quality speakers.
4. Adjusted the build flags for the PSP and Dreamcast emulators to achieve a slight performance improvement.
5. Fixed a bug where all core options in the ARMN64 and ARMGBA cores were displayed in Chinese.
6. Added the standalone Dolphin emulator (5.10 kernel only).
   - Press SELECT + START to exit a game.
   - Place GameCube ROMs in the `gc` directory and Wii ROMs in the `wii` directory.
   - Thanks to jokubasver.
7. Fixed an incorrect screen rotation issue in RetroArch on rotated-screen devices.
8. Removed the PortMaster dependency. Users who need PortMaster should update it manually.
9. Updated the `rk817_codec` driver in both the 5.10 and 4.4 kernels.
   - Thanks to jokubasver.
10. Added the malisx2 0.6.1 driver.
11. Added Kodi, accessible from the ArkOS4Clone menu under EmulationStation.
    - RK3326 supports hardware video decoding for H.264, HEVC (H.265), MPEG-1, MPEG-2, MPEG-4, and VP8.
12. Added the 3DS emulator core (5.10 kernel only).
    - Game decryption is not available by default.
    - To enable on-device game decryption, compile `lcdyk0517/3dsdec` and place the resulting executable in `/usr/local/bin`.
    - Place `boot9.bin` in `/roms/bios`.
    - Place 3DS games in `/roms/3ds`.
13. Added a PS2 emulator.
    - Vulkan is supported on both the 4.4.189 and 5.10.252 kernels.
    - Place BIOS files in `/roms/bios`.
    - Place games in `/roms/ps2`.
    - Press SELECT + X to open the emulator menu. Configure the controls and settings as needed.

detail.readme:
# (d)ArkOS 4.4 Kernel Porting for Unsupported Devices

Bringing **(d)ArkOS 4.4 kernel** porting to unsupported devices. Contributions via PRs are always welcome.

> 💡 Use the [DTB Analysis Tool](https://lcdyk0517.github.io/dtbTools.html) to identify your clone type or request support for unsupported devices.

> 🔧 Use the [DTB Customization Tool](https://lcdyk0517.github.io/tools/dtb-tools.html) to customize your device settings, including joystick axis remapping, button mapping, battery capacity, and screen refresh rate.

> ⚠️ Please make sure to read the [Wiki](https://github.com/lcdyk0517/arkos4clone/wiki) thoroughly before use.

> 📝 **[View Changelog](Changelog.md)**

---

## Collaborators

- [@jokubasver](https://github.com/jokubasver) — mainly maintains support for **kernel 5.10.252**.

---

## Support the Project

![devices](https://r36s.dpdns.org/devices.jpg)

If you find (d)ArkOS4Clone helpful and want to support future development:

[![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/lcdyk)

Thank you for your support! 🙏
